purpose: Single fail-closed acceptance matrix. This file is the machine-readable source of truth for required gates; dated evidence lives in the separately keyed exact-head evidence index.

review_snapshot.overall_reason: No integrated candidate has exact-current-head PASS evidence for all required gates. A scoped historical PASS cannot satisfy a different SHA, stack or gate.

status_policy.pass_rule: PASS is permitted only when the required oracle actually ran and passed on the exact reviewed candidate SHA, with workflow/run/attempt, tested SHA, engine/version, environment, scope, command/exit code, and required artifacts verified.
status_policy.fail_rule: FAIL means a target-applicable exact-SHA required check actually executed and failed. Preserve the failure, command, engine and run identity.
status_policy.blocked_rule: BLOCKED means a prerequisite, preflight, target-engine mismatch or unresolved dependency prevents the required oracle from qualifying. A failed preflight is not proof that downstream tests executed.
status_policy.not_run_rule: NOT RUN / NOT VERIFIED means no qualifying exact-scope evidence was located. Do not infer success from file presence, a runbook, a green parent workflow or an earlier SHA.
status_policy.historical_rule: Historical evidence rows are immutable records. Never change their SHA, run ID, engine, environment, scope or result to reflect a newer branch.
status_policy.wrong_engine_rule: MariaDB-only execution can be recorded as PASS/FAIL for MariaDB at that exact SHA, but is ineligible for PostgreSQL 17 acceptance.
status_policy.aggregate_rule: Overall status cannot be PASS while any required check is FAIL, BLOCKED or NOT RUN / NOT VERIFIED; there is no partial/aggregate GREEN.
